selection_basis: Layout groups come from camera-geometry and map.png identity (dataset_audit.py). Clips/cameras were chosen from ground-truth statistics and alignment overlays only; no detector output existed when this file was written.

dataset.name: NVIDIA PhysicalAI-SmartSpaces / MTMC_Tracking_2026
dataset.license: CC-BY-4.0 (HF dataset card; synthetic data, Omniverse/IsaacSim)
dataset.provenance_class: SYNTHETIC warehouse footage. Not real industrial footage; not a customer stream.
dataset.video: H.264 High, yuv420p, 1920x1080, 30 fps, no B-frames, constant PTS step 1/30 s, keyframe every 30 frames
dataset.labels: ground_truth.json per scene: per-frame 2D boxes of objects visible in each camera (visibility fraction not provided)

calibration.role: choose the operating confidence threshold only; never used for reported quality

development.role: pipeline debugging, parity checks, timing shakedown, ground-truth/video alignment sweep

holdout.role: reported result; run once per runtime configuration after this file and the calibration threshold are fixed; no tuning on it

scoring.ap: COCO-style 101-point interpolated AP at IoU 0.5 ('AP50') over detections with score >= 0.001, one class, one camera
scoring.size_policy: GT person boxes with native-resolution height < 32 px are IGNORE regions: a detection matched to one, or an unmatched detection with native height < 32 px, is neither TP nor FP. All-size numbers are also reported.

operating_threshold.selected_on: calibration clip, B0 offline full clip
operating_threshold.rule: maximise F1 at IoU 0.5 over grid 0.05..0.95 step 0.05
operating_threshold.note: filled into results/edge_inference/calibration.json before any development/holdout scoring

scoring.unlabeled_frames: reported separately; none expected (every frame index has an annotation record)
scoring.dropped_frame_scoring: a dropped frame produces no detections and is scored as such; 'quality including drops' is reported next to 'quality of processed frames'
scoring.statistics: frames are temporally correlated: report per-clip results; CIs from block bootstrap over contiguous 10 s (300-frame) blocks, 1000 resamples, seed 20261104. No per-frame i.i.d. intervals.

model.name: torchvision.models.detection.ssdlite320_mobilenet_v3_large
model.postprocess: softmax; label 1 only; score>0.001; top-300; BoxCoder weights (10,10,5,5), clip to 320x320; NMS IoU 0.55; boxes scaled to native resolution
model.deviation_from_official: person-only (no cross-class 300 cap); measured against official model(img) output in parity checks

runtimes.B0: PyTorch 2.x FP32 eager CPU: network only, shared pre/post. Correctness reference, not a performance competitor.
runtimes.B1: ONNX Runtime CPUExecutionProvider, ORT_ENABLE_ALL, same network exported at fixed 1x3x320x320, same shared pre/post. Optimised deployment CPU control.

streaming.pacing: frame i is released at t0 + pts_i (original 30 fps timing, perf_counter clock), packets decoded by a feeder thread at release time
streaming.queue: bounded FIFO of decoded frames, capacity 2; when full the OLDEST frame not yet started is dropped (latest-wins) and logged
streaming.latency_definition: output_done - release time of that frame's packet (includes decode, queue wait, preprocess, inference, postprocess)
streaming.deadline_note: ILLUSTRATIVE (about 3 frame periods). No customer deadline is known; percentiles are the primary result.
streaming.warmup: 50 untimed inferences on the first decoded frame before t0

offline.purpose: model quality, parity, determinism: every frame, no pacing

energy: NOT MEASURED. No power meter. CPU utilisation, latency and thread counts are diagnostic only; no energy is inferred.
